in_marathi.name: Bhairu
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Fearless, Powerful, Strong
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bhairu हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Bhairu is a Sanskrit name derived from Bhairava, the fierce form of Lord Shiva. This name signifies fearlessness, strength, and power. Bhairu is revered for his courage and bravery, and is often invoked to ward off evil influences.
